Package info.openrocket.core.simulation

Class FlightDataBranch

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.DataBranch<info.openrocket.core.simulation.FlightDataType>
info.openrocket.core.simulation.FlightDataBranch
All Implemented Interfaces:
info.openrocket.core.util.Monitorable
public class FlightDataBranch extends info.openrocket.core.simulation.DataBranch<info.openrocket.core.simulation.FlightDataType>
A single branch of flight data. The data is ordered based on some variable, typically time. It also contains flight events that have occurred during simulation.

After instantiating a FlightDataBranch data and new variable types can be added to the branch. A new data point (a value for each variable defined) is created using DataBranch.addPoint() after which the value for each variable type can be set using DataBranch.setValue(T, double). Each variable type does NOT have to be set, unset values will default to NaN. New variable types not defined in the constructor can be added using DataBranch.setValue(T, double), they will be created and all previous values will be set to NaN.

After populating a FlightDataBranch object it can be made immutable by calling DataBranch.immute().

    • FlightDataBranch

      public FlightDataBranch(String name, info.openrocket.core.rocketcomponent.RocketComponent srcComponent, FlightDataBranch parent)
      Make a flight data branch with all data points copied from its parent. Intended for use when creating a new branch upon stage separation, so the data at separation is present in both branches (and if the new branch has an immediate exception, it can be plotted)
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the new branch.
      srcComponent - the component that is the source of the new branch.
      parent - the parent branch to copy data from.
